requiredGates.requirement: Reviewed main source, immutable release archive and every executable match the selected lock and required green Foundation run.
Complete required source correctness, feature variants, analyzers and packaging pass on the exact released source revision.
Complete required upstream conformance passes without weakening baselines, assertions, tolerances or unsupported-result handling.
Required application, broker, provisioning and released-runtime integration gates pass on settled main.
Full 8192-token Swift scalar/NEON logits, complete live FP16 KV and recurrent/convolution state match pinned native reference within 1e-3 + 1e-3 * abs(reference).
Exact prompt/template tokens, supplied reasoning history, MT19937 draw ordering, seeded replay and stop/output-limit semantics match the pinned native contract.
4096-token output at the 8192-token context bound, long conversations, count/generation identity, Stop, abandonment, deadlines, backend loss and fresh retry preserve committed history without replay.

Actual-model full-context peak private/Job/resident/system memory obeys 15.5 GiB admission, 11.5 GiB Job commit and 4 GiB physical reserve without sustained paging; pressure shuts down the owned worker.
Pinned adapter executes in the full Swift graph with verified residual-writer/SSM basis, loaded-at-zero response/logits identity and nonzero logits application.
Paired same-engine standard LoRA scale 1.3 trials preserve every required per-prompt decode-TPS gate and bounded adapter memory premium; retain losing outcomes.
Independent human reviews of exact hashed paired scale-1.3 responses pass each required quality dimension without refusal/quality tradeoffs.

Actual-model restricted identity denies unrelated files/credentials/egress and same-user bypass, proves broker-only communication, authenticated numeric-loopback framing, bounded consumption and owned cleanup without weaker fallback.
Actual native application qualifies speech/chat overlap, encrypted recovery, offline restart, explicit retry, stalled consumers and descendant cleanup with the released runtime.
Owner-reviewed sustained responsiveness/heat/fan and creative usefulness show no material quality, security, memory or comfort regression versus the retained control.
Clean-machine ARM64 install, exact package/dependency notices, offline launch, upgrade/recovery and explicit pinned native fallback reproduce on settled main.

Matched original-PQ2/current-weight-PTQ1 trials on the same pinned runtime, device, standard adapter at 1.3 and worker policy retain complete responses, cold load, prefill, decode, end-to-end latency, resources and losing outcomes; demonstrate at least 10% lower end-to-end latency or a reviewed capacity/energy benefit within accepted latency and quality limits.

The selected released private service and worker explicitly verify the pinned adapter identity, advertise matching readiness and support scale 1.3 plus bounded 0..2 changes with fresh compatible state. Canonical count/generation, zero/nonzero streaming, cancellation, reset and rollback reject stale adapter/scale state. A source-only graph or adapter-disabled service cannot satisfy this gate.

Independently verify every current-weight PTQ1 block reconstructs the exact original PQ2 symbols and raw scales, other tensor bytes and tokenizer/transform identities; bind both artifact hashes and the complete export receipt. Packing parity alone establishes no activation, logits or state parity.

Explicitly restore the retained original PQ2 artifact with the pinned released runtime, standard adapter/scale and worker policy, then verify readiness, response and owned cleanup without replay or weaker containment. Preserve the exact original artifact on disk and the unchanged admission/reserve policy.
